title: Grosse Ile Fishing Charters

services.name: Charter Info
services.desc: Fishing trips will typically begin at 7:00a.m., but depending on how the fish are biting we could leave earlier. I will tell you the day before your charter what fishing license to buy (Michigan or Canadian) depending on where the fishing is best. All people that plan on fishing need a valid fishing license in their possession. Location - I will pick you up by boat from Smiths Boat Livery (27490 River Lane, Grosse Ile MI, 48138) All anglers 18 and older are required to have a fishing license. When fishing Canada, each person on board will need to have one of the following documents to prove identity 1) Driver's license 2) passport or passport
